CHRISTIAN RELIGIOUS EDUCATION — TERMLY EXAM #11
====

GRADE: Grade 11
SUBJECT: CHRISTIAN RELIGIOUS EDUCATION
TIME ALLOWED: 1 hour 30 minutes
TOTAL MARKS: 50
EXAM BODY: KNEC / KCSE pathway

INSTRUCTIONS
----
1. Answer all questions.
2. For calculations, show formula → substitution → steps → final answer with units.
3. For multiple choice, choose the best option.
4. Check your work before submitting.

SECTION A — MULTIPLE CHOICE
----

   B. Apply the teaching of Prophet Jeremiah with respect, honesty, and care for others in Kenya.
   C. Use Prophet Jeremiah to insult classmates of other faiths.
   D. Ignore safety and kindness while discussing Prophet Jeremiah.
